subject: Win path starter packet + collaborative timeline
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@hollowayhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Win path starter packet + collaborative timeline

Elaine —

Thanks again for the time today. As promised, I attached a lightweight starter packet to help us align on the evaluation checkpoints and the close timeline. The packet has two pieces: a one-page "win path" outline (goals, primary stakeholders, success metrics, must-have vs nice-to-have) and a week0-onboarding slate for the pilot.

Links/attachments: Redwood_WinPath_Starter_Packet_v1.gdoc (co-editable) and Week0-Onboarding-Slate.pptx (slides we can customize).

Next steps I propose:
- You and your stakeholders review the doc and add/flag any missing milestones (especially compliance gates).
- We run a 30-min alignment workshop next week to finalize owners and a 60-day pilot acceptance matrix.
- Redwood will populate a short procurement checklist for legal/security to speed the purchase order.

Can you confirm the best time for a 30-min sync next Tue/Wed? Also, who should we add from your security/compliance team so we can surface SOC2 evidence in the doc?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | (415) 555-0112

Attachments: Redwood_WinPath_Starter_Packet_v1.gdoc (Google Doc link stub), Week0-Onboarding-Slate.pptx (pptx)

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@hollowayhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-28T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Win path starter packet + collaborative timeline

Marcus —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear template. A few notes from my side after skimming:
- We need a compliance milestone early in the timeline that verifies data residency and KMS integration — can you add a section that lists typical artifacts Redwood provides (SOC2 report, data retention policy, network diagram)?
- Procurement will want an estimated TCO line item for Dedicated vs Hosted for a 90-day pilot. Can Marissa or Jonas help add that?
- Please add our security lead (cc procurement) to the doc:
  - Security: Prashant Iyer <prashant.iyer@hollowayhealth.com>
  - Procurement: procurement@hollowayhealth.com

I can do Tue morning (10–11am PT) for the 30-min alignment but would like an agenda: acceptance metrics, compliance checklist, pilot success criteria, and decision date.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Director of Product Operations | Holloway Health
elaine.park@hollowayhealth.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@hollowayhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-01T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Win path starter packet + collaborative timeline

Elaine — thanks for the notes, and welcome Prashant and procurement. I've done a quick pass and added a "Compliance & Evidence" appendix to the doc that enumerates: SOC 2 Type II (link to report stub), data retention options, KMS/HSM integrations we support, and a sample network diagram. Marissa will drop an estimated pilot cost table (Hosted vs Dedicated) into the pricing section.

Agenda for the 30-min workshop (proposed):
1) 5m — Introductions & success metric confirmation
2) 10m — Compliance gates & evidence owners (Prashant to confirm owners)
3) 10m — Pilot acceptance criteria and measurement plan
4) 5m — Next steps: procurement items & decision date

Can we lock Tue 2027-03-02 at 10:00am PT? If that works I will send a calendar invite and attach the doc link.

Note: doc link (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDeF-RedwoodMapSeed — please comment directly in the "Acceptance matrix" table so we can track owner assignments.

Best,
Marcus

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-02T07:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Win path starter packet + collaborative timeline

Elaine / Marcus —

I've added a simple Hosted vs Dedicated estimate into the pricing tab of the starter packet (line items: projected token volume, GPU-hours, expected latency SLO, and optional retention/add-on costs). It's intentionally conservative for the pilot — we flagged a "scale buffer" for bursts and a recommended cache configuration that typically reduces token spend 18–22% on our healthcare workloads.

Also added a short checklist under "Compliance & Evidence": link to SOC2 summary, typical network diagram stub, and our standard KMS integration flow. Prashant — if you want the full evidence pack I can share a SOC2 redacted PDF after NDA step.

Marcus — Tue 3/2 10:00am PT works for me. Please go ahead and send the invite.

—Marissa
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: Week0-Onboarding-Slate.pptx (slide stub)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@hollowayhealth.com>
Date: 2027-03-03T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Win path starter packet + collaborative timeline

All —

Invite sent for Tue 2027-03-02 10:00am PT (30 mins). Meeting agenda attached to the invite and I've pinned the editable doc to the calendar event. High level confirm: acceptance metric owners will be captured in the "Acceptance matrix" table during the session; Marissa will own the pilot cost estimates; Marcus will own procurement coordination.

Elaine / Prashant — if you can drop security contacts or initial comments into the "Compliance & Evidence" section before the call that will speed the workshop. Otherwise we'll capture actions and circulate a short MAP (mutual action plan) immediately after the workshop with owners and due dates.

Thanks — see you Tue.

Jonas Weber
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
